entries.wish: We need lists for conjugations in Spanish. Front is the verb name in spanish, and back is the list of 6 forms (on 6 lines) at a given tense. 1/3 regular verbs and 2/3 irregular ones, around 60 verbs. We need 'Présent', 'Subjonctif présent', 'Subjonctif Imparfait forme 1' and 'Subjonctif Imparfait forme 2'.
entries.done: Created four lists in the Spanish folder — « Présent », « Subjonctif présent », « Subjonctif imparfait – forme 1 » (en -ra) and « Subjonctif imparfait – forme 2 » (en -se). Each holds the same 60 verbs in the same order, 20 regular and 40 irregular, front the infinitive and back the six forms on six lines, Peninsular Spanish so the fifth line is the vosotros form. The two imperfect-subjunctive lists were checked against each other: all 360 forms share the same stem, as they must.

entries.wish: In the English folder to a list of irregular verbs. Front is the french verb (e.g. savoir) and back is the list of three forms e.g. "know / knew / known". Do a comprehensive list and just drop verbs which are totally outdated but go beyond the usual list of the common ones. This list is intended for excellent French students.
entries.done: Created the list « Verbes irréguliers » in the English folder: 179 cards, front the French infinitive, back the three English forms. Comprehensive rather than the usual short list; archaic verbs (beget, cleave, smite…) left out, and three that are no longer irregular in standard English (dive, fit, knit) left out too.
